trigger_definition: CREATE TRIGGER category_snapshot_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.product_categories FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_active_snapshot()
function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_active_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
        BEGIN
          IF NEW.active_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM source_snapshots s WHERE s.id = NEW.active_snapshot_id
            AND s.category_id = NEW.id AND s.status = 'published'
          ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'active snapshot must be published and category-scoped'; END IF;
          RETURN NEW;
        END $function$
